_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless), read with calculate_tile_properties with map_gen_settings.seed FORCED to 123456 (map seed 123456). Three lever cases, each setting all three Aquilo resource controls (aquilo_crude_oil, lithium_brine, fluorine_vent) and reading them back (`controls` holds the read-back values). The default case is game.planets["aquilo"].create_surface(); the others are game.create_surface() with its map_gen_settings, and the default case read on such a copy came back bit-identical to the planet surface. Each case is one batch, in the order of its `positions` (1/256 grid, within 1200 tiles of the origin); each field is the hex of its f32, one per position. entity:<name>:probability: see `icebergRoutes` for which route answered; the data-stage route is the iceberg prototype's own probability_expression as a named noise expression. Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values for every case. Positions: per case, the first 64 positions of a 16384-position scout pool where each quota field passes its test, then the first 128 others, in pool order; `quotas` records any shortfall. Captured by scripts/probes/aquilo-fields.
